views.markdown: Animated Face ID for notched iPhones. The lock turns into a Face ID face that waits for you while Face ID looks (and on the passcode screen), curls into a spinning ring with a check when you unlock, and shakes like jelly when it does not recognize you. Made by nano.
New icon, live demo in Settings
One face animation: he's waiting on you.
Unlocking is Apple-like (white ring spins, then a check), and the face has two animations that take turns.
Lock-sized, plain (no glass), the face also replaces the lock on the passcode screen, and unlocking turns it into a glowing blue ring that spins, wobbles and bursts into blue sparks.
No island: the Face ID face itself, in liquid glass, where the lock is. It curls into a glass ring that spins and wobbles like liquid and pops when you unlock.

A Dynamic Island style Face ID for notched iPhones. When Face ID starts looking, a black island drips out of the notch and grows into a rounded square with a Face ID glyph that scans; unlocking turns it into a check, then it pulls back up into the notch with a squish. No match: it shakes like jelly. Apple's own lock stays as it is (it only steps aside while the island is out). Only on iPhones with a notch: Dynamic Island iPhones already have this.
